basis: Known-actor, human-only, assignment-bound-to-current-inputs, self-review and supervisor-when-required guards precede the action branch independent of state.
Stored VALIDATING arises only from supervisor REOPEN or assigned-human CORRECT, both clearing assignments; ASSIGN refuses non-human and forbidden principals.
CORRECT carries only a replacement Case (no approval, decision or assignee).
CORRECT on CLOSED still refused; REOPEN remains supervisor-only.
REVALIDATE requires parent == current binding (store revision + case hash), so each correction invalidates pending approvals.
Both transitions already exist in ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS with no actor rules for these states; two transitions fit AuditEvent max_length=2.
M21 wraps authentication only, independent of action/state; M15 unaffected; M22 drives only DECIDE.

evidence_authentication: Integrity hashes only; no independent approval or signature asserted
